pages.excerpt:
The**Ministry of Labour and Social Economy**(**MITES**) is the[department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_government_departments)of the[Government of Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government_of_Spain)responsible for designing and implementing the government policy on[labour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Work_(human_activity))and[labour relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Labor_relations),[employment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Employment),[unemployment benefits](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unemployment_benefits)and[self-employment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Self-employment),[social economy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Social_economy)and[corporate social responsibility](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corporate_social_responsibility).[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_Labour_(Spain)#cite_note-:0-2)
